_note: Sources for the resource wire — control of resources, after Part 1(a) of Suppression. Three kinds. 'direct' are the institutions that make the rules and the projects that measure them, read from their own feeds. 'gnews' are Google News regional editions, one query per subject per edition, written so that a CONTROL term is always required: a sector word alone never qualifies, which is what keeps this from becoming a mining, farming or shipping wire. 'events' are standing watches on the recurring institutional acts — a programme approved, a concession awarded, an arbitration filed. Dead feeds are printed by verify_sources.py --dead.
